title: </sub>  Define zero-denominator recall behavior
text:
</sub>  Define zero-denominator recall behavior

When all ten qualifying pull requests have confirmed-clean external reviews—a case explicitly allowed by AC15(b)—the denominator defined here is zero. AC15(d) still permits a comparative recall claim once matched controls exist, but recall is undefined at 0/0, leaving implementers to choose among 0%, 100%, or N/A. Require at least one adjudicated external finding for a recall-effect claim, or specify that zero-denominator evidence is reported as N/A and cannot support such a claim.
